text:
maya: Quick status update — kernel perf sprint. Alpha milestone tomorrow EOD. Main asks: (1) KV cache prefill fix merged? (2) continuous-batching perf regression from last PR? (3) infra knobs for 2x mem headroom.

jonas: KV prefill fix is in PR, awaiting review. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3248

hiro: I ran a quick perf run on the canary. Continuous batching latency + tail got worse ~8% for 1k seq. Suspect lock contention in batch_assembler.

lina: Which test harness did you use? can you paste the `bench` command?

hiro: `./tools/bench --model=redwood-13b --seq=1024 --qps=200 --profile=tail` — added heap profiles to the PR comment.

maya: @jonas can you prioritize reviewing #3248? If we can't land prefill, warmup hit will impact canary. Also @eng-infra we need temp bump of pod memory to 48GB for the canary.

jonas: On it — I'll do a review after stand. If I see lock churn I'll propose a micro-queue approach.

sam: tagging ops-bot to request the memory bump.

ops-bot: @sam mem-bump request received for cluster `prod-canary-3`. ETA approval 2h. Ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/RT-4582

lina: Quick note: I pushed a small perf patch that removes an atomic in `kv_cache.cc` — inexpensive to review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3251

maya: Action items: 1) jonas review #3248 today, 2) eng-infra mem bump + canary, 3) hiro add micro-queue perf test, 4) lina + jonas sync on atomics patch. I'll update the milestone doc after reviews. Thanks :thumbsup:

jonas: ack

hiro: ack, will add tests and post numbers here.

lina: ack
